skill.name: architecture-decision-record

content.value_statement: Architecture decisions are often lost in chat threads and pull requests. This skill guides teams through ADR templates, reviews, examples, and lifecycle practices.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of ADRs with title, status, context, decision, consequences, alternatives, and references.
Provides a reusable Markdown ADR template for new technical decisions.
Includes YAML frontmatter fields for documentation systems that support structured metadata.
Offers a review checklist for quality, architecture fit, stakeholder approval, and lifecycle readiness.
Supplies complete example ADRs for microservices, PostgreSQL, and API versioning decisions.
limitations: Does not validate architecture decisions against live systems or repositories.
Does not create diagrams, migration plans, or implementation tickets by itself.
Requires users to supply real project context, stakeholders, constraints, and trade-offs.
Examples are illustrative and should be adapted before use in production documentation.

use_cases.title: Record a platform decision
use_cases.description: Create a clear ADR for a database, framework, cloud, or deployment choice before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Review a proposed ADR
use_cases.description: Check whether a draft has enough context, alternatives, consequences, owners, and approval information.

use_cases.title: Build team decision history
use_cases.description: Standardize ADR files so new team members can understand why important technical choices were made.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic ADR
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create a first draft from a decision summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me draft an ADR for this decision: [decision]. Include context, decision, consequences, alternatives, and references.

prompt_templates.title: Compare alternatives
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: evaluate options before selecting one.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create the alternatives section for an ADR comparing [option A], [option B], and [option C]. Include pros, cons, and rejection rationale.

prompt_templates.title: Review an ADR draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: assess quality before team approval.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this ADR draft for missing context, weak reasoning, unbalanced consequences, and unclear ownership: [paste ADR].

prompt_templates.title: Supersede an old decision
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: document architectural evolution without rewriting history.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a new ADR that supersedes ADR-[number]. Explain what changed, why the old decision no longer fits, and the migration impact.

output_examples.input: A team needs to choose PostgreSQL instead of DynamoDB for a new order service.
output_examples.output: A complete ADR draft with business context, the PostgreSQL decision, operational consequences, DynamoDB as an alternative, and review notes.

output_examples.input: A draft ADR only lists benefits for a microservices migration.
output_examples.output: A review response that asks for measurable risks, operational costs, team readiness, rollback plans, and a fair modular monolith alternative.

output_examples.input: An accepted API versioning ADR must be replaced by a new compatibility strategy.
output_examples.output: A superseding ADR outline that preserves the original decision history and documents the new compatibility approach.

best_practices: Document why the decision was made, not only what technology was selected.
Include real alternatives with balanced pros, cons, and rejection reasons.
Keep accepted ADRs immutable and create a new ADR when a decision changes.
anti_patterns: Using an ADR to describe low-level implementation steps instead of a durable decision.
Listing only benefits while hiding costs, risks, or operational impact.
Changing an accepted ADR in place instead of superseding it with a new record.

faq.question: What is an Architecture Decision Record?
faq.answer: An ADR is a short document that records an important technical decision, its context, alternatives, and consequences.

faq.question: When should I create an ADR?
faq.answer: Create one when a decision affects architecture, technology choices, team workflow, operations, or future development direction.

faq.question: Can this skill write a complete ADR?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure a complete draft when you provide the decision, constraints, stakeholders, and known trade-offs.

faq.question: Does this skill decide which architecture is best?
faq.answer: No. It helps document reasoning and compare alternatives, but final judgment should come from the responsible team.

faq.question: Does it support structured metadata?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a YAML frontmatter template for status, authors, relationships, tags, impact, review, and references.

faq.question: How does it help with reviews?
faq.answer: It provides checklist criteria for clarity, alternatives, consequences, ownership, lifecycle status, and stakeholder approval.
